program.name: Speed & Strength
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Running drills and sprints in place, then dumbbell strength: fast first, strong second.
program.about: Fast first, strong second. Each session opens with a circuit of running drills and sprints in place, A-skips, wall drives and fast feet, while the legs are fresh. Then comes dumbbell or kettlebell strength in straight sets, legs one day and upper body the next. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds reps.
